title: Camera subscriber
description: Subscribe to /camera/image_raw and print the width and height of each received image.
steps: Inspect /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic info.
Subscribe to Image and print msg.width and msg.height in the callback.
Run the node and check the repeated output.
hints: A camera is another publisher. Use ros2 topic list and ros2 topic info /camera/image_raw.
Create an Image subscription with self.image_callback and queue depth 10.
